headline: Local Government Program Assistant
summary: Public administration graduate looking for a program assistant post in local government or a public authority. During my OJT I helped run a livelihood assistance program: I assisted residents at the help desk, encoded applications and joined community orientations in the barangays.

projects.name: Livelihood assistance help desk
bullets: Assisted about 50 residents a day with application forms and requirements.
Encoded 900 applications and checked them for missing requirements.

projects.name: Barangay youth survey
projects.description: Surveyed 200 young people in Tandag on job interests and presented the results at a barangay assembly.

skills: Government service support at the help desk
Clear spoken English, Filipino and Surigaonon

experience.title: Program Assistant Intern (OJT)
experience.employer: Surigao del Sur Coastal Livelihood Authority
bullets: Staffed the help desk for the livelihood assistance program and answered residents' questions.
Joined program orientations in six coastal barangays.
